concerns.text: The plan constructs the therapy‑response signature from the `therapy_response` column of GSE138852 (the same dataset used for downstream enrichment testing) and then validates fork‑point genes against this signature (Fisher’s exact test + t‑test). This makes the validation target definitionally dependent on the predictor data, creating a circular/tautological validation that will inevitably produce significant enrichment by construction rather than independent evidence.
